name: Lofoten (Arctic links: heather, bare rock, white shell sand)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Lofoten Links on Gimsøya, 68° N: short, cool-green links turf on the fairways and greens, a heather-and-crowberry rough in brown-purple (F0-F2), grey granite and gneiss (K), near-white shell sand in the bunkers and on the beaches, and a deep, cold blue-green Norwegian Sea. Few trees: low downy birch. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these. Course chat's proposal 2026-11-13 (no open orthophoto: colours from the course's character, not from a photo).
